scope: Fictional controls only; raw Ollama request experiments, not end-to-end Rust publication replays; baseline system task was asserted byte-equal to current production TASK. Existing uncommitted code preserved.
starting_point: Experimental period-card slice is deployed and operational; v19 structural success still fails factual fidelity. Source identity verification is not semantic claim validation.

reuse_decisions.Rig: Keep existing system/context/provider separation. No framework or compatible fact-verification component demonstrated by the inspected builder.
reuse_decisions.Haystack: Borrow claim-by-claim faithfulness review; required prompt-variable validation concerns input presence, not factual truth. Reuse existing offline evaluation home instead of importing Python pipeline.
reuse_decisions.Semantic Kernel: Existing plugin prompt.rs already owns task/input contract. Directory-based prompt plugins supply no factual acceptance gate.
reuse_decisions.LlamaIndex: Numbered-source citations help traceability, not entailment. Do not adopt citation engine or whole-answer binary/refine evaluator as a correctness certificate.

generation_experiments.ordering_diagnostic: support-first was emitted after body; basis-before-card was actually emitted first. Both failures retained.
generation_experiments.controlled_variables: Same case evidence, model, temperature 0, context 32768, output budget 600, think false. Baseline vs candidate changes both task and output schema; this comparison does not isolate a single causal component. Corrected order renames support to basis.

retained-unbound.baseline: Invents target affiliation for the coaches; source text does not name Cedar Comets.
retained-unbound.support-first: Invents leadership change and affiliation despite matching source quotes.
retained-unbound.basis-before-card: Invents significant coaching-staff change and effects on performance/morale after exact quotations.

bound-contrasting-speakers.baseline: Generalizes two individuals to a divided team and possible morale/performance effects.
bound-contrasting-speakers.support-first: Contrasting reactions are mostly retained, but score 75 conflicts with the mixed reading.
bound-contrasting-speakers.basis-before-card: Preserves individual attribution and contrasting reactions with score 50; small positive control, not proof of general reliability.

single-supporter-hope.baseline: Prose preserves narrow attribution; score 50 does not match the hopeful statement.
single-supporter-hope.support-first: Score 75 fits hope, but adds anticipation about team performance.
single-supporter-hope.basis-before-card: Generalizes Alex to supporters and explicitly describes score 75 as balanced/mixed.

routine-schedule.baseline: Invents schedule release/upcoming season and publishes score 50 for unknown emotion.
routine-schedule.support-first: Matches a schedule quotation but still invents upcoming season and publishes unknown emotion.
routine-schedule.basis-before-card: Returns an empty basis but publishes a score-50 card instead of nulls.

negated-emotion.baseline: Invents gender, recent performance/victory and a prior headline; unknown feelings become score 50.
negated-emotion.support-first: Invents gender and performance; denial is quoted as support for a score-50 card.
negated-emotion.basis-before-card: Same unsupported gender/performance and unknown-emotion card despite copied denial.

late-qualification.baseline: Invents gender and uses score 50 despite no current stated emotional reaction.
late-qualification.support-first: Copies only conditional relief; invents gender and publishes score 50 despite current-relief denial.
late-qualification.basis-before-card: Copies conditional relief plus denial, but invents current hope/caution and publishes score 75.

generation_experiments.decision: Do not adopt either citation/output-contract variant. Valid source substrings did not prevent unsupported narrative or incorrect abstention.
generation_experiments.limits: Small hand-reviewed development controls. No held-out real-source accuracy claim.

publication_semantics: Unsupported or unverified generation should remain a failed durable attempt using the existing receipt/error path; do not mark selected evidence used or erase the previous card. Correct abstention must remain a separate outcome.
non_solutions: Quotation substring checks as proof of body truth
Trusting model-supplied citations as a factual verdict
Using relevance probability as factual entailment or emotional score
Requiring every card to be non-null
Uncalibrated LLM judge as an automatic production gate

claim_audit_prototype.pattern: Haystack-style exhaustive statement extraction and support checking, tested independently of generation using installed Granite; not an automatic production gate.
expected_gates: reject routine schedule with fabricated emotion
claim_audit_prototype.initial_attempt: One retained response ended with done_reason=length after 900 reasoning tokens, empty visible content. Batch interrupted during subsequent work.
claim_audit_prototype.explicit_think_false_retry: First request timed out at 120 seconds. Batch interrupted during subsequent work. Remaining controls were not evaluated.
claim_audit_prototype.decision: Inconclusive. No verified detection rate or faithful-card acceptance result. No automatic judge adoption.
claim_audit_prototype.limits: Installed critic model/transport behavior must be resolved before auditing semantic accuracy; neither failed nor missing verdict is a pass.

earlier_recommended_next_step: Calibrate an exhaustive claim-support audit in existing offline evaluation/judge.rs against human-reviewed real-source cases and deliberate single-claim mutations. Only after evidence supports it, add a fail-closed support check before returning a publishable VibeOutput. This is a proposed additional verification stage, not an implemented or proven cure. It changes the present single-model-call contract and adds inference cost.
recommended_next_step: Superseded by user direction: a verifier does not improve generation. Session closed without a demonstrated fidelity solution; user will pursue a different approach in another session. Do not automatically resume this branch.
